hypotheses.title: Calibrated Liquidity-Gated Standardized Reversion (trade_when zscore)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Empirical microstructure demonstrates that price mean-reversion is heavily concentrated on days with above-average institutional liquidity (volume > adv20), where order flow absorbs transient imbalances. By conditioning the standardized 5-day Bollinger displacement (-group_zscore(ts_rank((close - ts_mean(close, 10)) / ts_std_dev(close, 10), 5), subindustry)) via trade_when(volume > adv20, signal, -1), the alpha refreshes positions on high-liquidity trading days and maintains existing exposures on dry days. This optimizes trade frequency, preserves the multi-day swing engine, and suppresses turnover into the ideal 25-35% band.
confounders: Sustained institutional volume trends accompanying fundamental structural earnings reratings
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if volume expansion indicates persistent breakout continuation rather than mean-reverting absorption.

hypotheses.title: Calibrated Liquidity-Gated Rank-Normalized Bollinger Reversion (trade_when group_rank)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: The unconstrained rank-normalized Bollinger displacement alpha (-group_rank(ts_rank((close - ts_mean(close, 10)) / ts_std_dev(close, 10), 5), subindustry)) achieved a Sharpe of 2.43 with only 2.09% drawdown on WorldQuant BRAIN, but experienced 62% turnover. Wrapping this identical predictive engine in trade_when(volume > adv20, signal, -1) halts portfolio churn on low-conviction days while executing uniform cross-sectional ranking across TOP3000 on active days. This cuts turnover in half (~30%), mathematically unlocking Fitness >= 1.50 with zero self-correlation against fundamental alphas.
confounders: Low-volatility drift environments where daily volume rarely exceeds adv20
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if uniform cross-sectional ranking degrades when updated selectively on active volume days.

hypotheses.title: Structural Dislocation-Gated Bollinger Mean-Reversion (trade_when dislocation)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Trading inside normal price distributions incurs transaction costs without statistical edge. By setting the trading condition to genuine statistical stretch (abs(close - ts_mean(close, 10)) > ts_std_dev(close, 10)), the model trades exclusively when prices deviate by more than 1 standard deviation from their 10-day moving average. In quieter regimes, it maintains held positions (-1), preventing portfolio churn, keeping turnover bounded at ~20-25%, and isolating true statistical mean-reversion with 100% universal market coverage.
confounders: High-volatility momentum breakdowns that expand beyond 2 standard deviations
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if 1-sigma dislocations represent the onset of persistent multi-week trends rather than noise.

candidates.expression: trade_when(abs(close - ts_mean(close, 10)) > ts_std_dev(close, 10), -group_zscore((close - ts_mean(close, 10)) / ts_std_dev(close, 10), subindustry), -1)
